name: pair-rehearsal
description: Two notes files and one article of the constitution that only the pair breaks: each file may say an agent worked on it, but not both. For rehearsing the gate on combinations with scripted agents, no model needed.

constitution.statement: At most one of notes/a.txt and notes/b.txt says that an agent worked on it.

claims.statement: notes/a.txt carries a line from the agent that worked on it.
notes/b.txt carries a line from the agent that worked on it.
